full_sentence: Never once in his career did he admit to a mistake.
acceptable_variants: did he ever admit to a mistake.

options.why_wrong: After the negative adverbial 'never once', the auxiliary must come before the subject; leaving the normal word order is ungrammatical.

options.text: did he admit to a mistake.
he did admit to a mistake.
options.why_wrong: Emphatic 'did' does not replace the required inversion after a fronted negative adverbial.

options.text: he has never admitted a mistake.
options.why_wrong: This is a plain statement with normal word order, so it does not complete the fronted negative structure that the stem sets up.

grammar_focus: Subject-auxiliary inversion after the fronted negative adverbial 'never once'
explanation: A negative adverbial at the start of a sentence requires the auxiliary 'did' before the subject, so the completion must read 'did he admit'.
